revision_label: Retained logic region: real return plane and 254 checked via escapes
scope: One-motherboard IS-2 engineering: retained FPGA/power/watchdog region with actual partial copper, not a full motherboard or fabrication release.

boards.title: Motherboard retained logic region - actual partial copper
boards.summary: 327 retained source parts with 1181 tracks/vias and one filled LOGIC_GND zone. Independent unconnected count460. New peripheral source integration is separate unfinished PCB work; this220x100mm envelope is the retained region, not the final motherboard.

layout_rules.basis: Selected VSSOP pads have 0.15mm gaps; PCBWay standard published trace/spacing floor is0.1mm. Power, BGA escape and final stackup need separate review.

boards.outline_status: 220 × 100 mm proposed standing card. Six copper layers and 1.6 mm thickness are layout assumptions; stackup and fabrication process remain unqualified.

zones.label: P1 / P2, other Ioff, identity, SSR, restore — pending

open_work: Motor/TX Ioff source circuits are connected; other card-bound Ioff paths, presence filters, identity/temperature, slot-status register and flash restore remain absent.
Bank-B buffer OE and OPI_BOE clear share one physical net; its upstream qualification and powered receiver enable pull-ups are not implemented here.
P1/P2 connector gender/orientation correction is a proposed IS-2 change; native connector footprint, contact-to-net map and cage mechanics remain open.
New output/progress/OPI/trip and full I/O GPIO allocation require a separate vendor FPGA fit. Existing six/two runtime is historical and incompatible with the new watchdog pulse contract.
Power loops, BGA escape, plane assignment, loaded fault timing, EMC, thermal behavior and physical bring-up remain unqualified.
Six-layer count is a layout candidate, not an approved stackup or a cost quote. No fabrication release.
